name: Write Compliant Cold Email
summary: Write concise B2B outreach grounded in relevance, verifiable claims, and respectful follow-up.
description: Write or review a bounded B2B cold-email sequence using lawful targeting, evidence-based relevance, peer-level language, one clear ask, and opt-out handling. Use when an approved prospecting program needs message copy after audience and compliance decisions are complete.
risk_reason: This skill writes concise B2B outreach grounded in relevance, verifiable claims, and respectful follow-up; it does not bypass opt-outs, spam controls, platform rules, or legal review.
refuses: It does not harvest private addresses, infer sensitive traits, impersonate a peer, or fabricate research.
It does not bypass opt-outs, spam controls, platform rules, or legal review.
It does not send messages, configure domains, or claim compliance from copy alone.

operational.latency_reason: The skill writes concise B2B outreach grounded in relevance, verifiable claims, and respectful follow-up, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
